findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager (CFPM) who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

There was not a CFPM available during the inspection. The PIC stated that his had lapsed and he had not re-done it yet. They were instructed to have enough CFPMs available to cover all shifts that have food handling in the facility.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

On arrival the hand sink nearest to the door was blocked with a trash can. The inspector moved the can in order to begin the inspection quicker and discussed the situation with the PIC later in the inspection. Education was conducted with the PIC during the inspection. Ensure that all hand sinks are readily accessible at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.comment: The signed employee health reporting agreement forms for each employee were not available during the inspection. The person-in-charge (PIC) stated that employees will sign the forms. The inspector provided blank copies to the PIC for each employee to sign. Ensure all employees sign and maintain employee health reporting agreement forms on-site. The inspector will follow up on 02/20/2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A). [PF]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Food debris was observed in the handwashing sink which prevented water from draining quickly. CORRECTED - The PIC was informed and the food debris was removed. Ensure employees use the handwashing sink for handwashing purposes only and the sink should not be blocked with food debris to prevent water from flowing easily.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Food debris were observed on clean dishes at the dish washing area. CORRECTED - The PIC was informed and the dishes were placed in the dish machine. Ensure dishes are cleaned to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [PF]

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Food processors were observed on the counter with water in them and not inverted for proper drying. CORRECTED - The PIC was informed and the food processors were moved to the dish rack and inverted for proper drying. Ensure utensils are stored in a self-draining position that allows air drying.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(B) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (B) Clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS shall be stored as specified under (A) of this section and shall be stored: (1) In a self-draining position that allows air drying; and (2) Covered or inverted. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The grate and the tray on the non-working cooler used for storing baking trays were observed to have accumulation of food residue. The PIC was instructed to have the food residue removed before the next routine inspection. Ensure the grate and tray are cleaned to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink by the three-compartment sink was observed to be in need of caulking. The PIC was informed to have the handwashing sink caulked to the wall to allow for easy and smooth cleaning. Ensure the handwashing sink is caulked before the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Dirty water and the mop head were observed in the mop bucket. CORRECTED -  The PIC was informed; the dirty water was discarded, and the mop head was placed in the wringer basket. Ensure mop water is discarded immediately after use and mop heads are properly stored by placing them in the wringer basket or hanging them to air-dry.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following area were observed to be in need of cleaning:

1. Soil accumulation and food debris were observed at the right corner under the prep sink.
2. Under the mat at the three-compartment sink was observed to have soil accumulation.
3. In-between the wall comings under the handwashing sink at the entrance was observed to have soil accumulation.
4. Food debris and soil accumulation were observed in a large hole covered with a grate at the cook line 

The PIC was instructed to have the areas mentioned above cleaned. Ensure the facility is cleaned as often as necessary, especially hidden areas.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. [C]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

On arrival the hand sink nearest to the door was blocked with trash cans and the rolling tray carrier. The dish person moved the items prior to discussion and prior to the arrival of the PIC. Education was conducted with the PIC during his inspection. Ensure that all hand sinks are readily accessible at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11(A) Equipment Food-Contact Surfaces and Utensils. (A) Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned: (5) At any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred.

The scoop holder for the ice machine is observed with contaminants in the standing water at the bottom. The ice scoop sits in this holder consistently throughout the day. The item and contaminants were shown to the PIC and moved to dish for cleaning. Ensure that all food contact items are cleaned regularly and specifically whenever contamination has occurred.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The edge of the deflector in both ice machines is soiled and in need of cleaning. The PIC was shown and had the items cleaned during this inspection to correct. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are maintained in a clean state at all times.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

An open can of soda was observed in one of the standing coolers in the kitchen. This can is on a wire shelf over and next to foods intended for residents. The PIC was shown and removed the can to correct. Employee personal foods can be in coolers so long as they are stored in a way that removes the possibility of contaminating other foods.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple knives and pans in the kitchen are observed with remaining food debris on them as they are in storage as ready-for-use. These items were shown to the PIC and moved back to dish for recleaning. Ensure that all food contact items are completely cleaned prior to storage/use. It is highly suggested that the dish washers are educated to review dishes after washing and prior to storage.

findings.citation_text:
4-602.11(A) Equipment Food-Contact Surfaces and Utensils. (A) Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned: (5) At any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred.

The scoop holder for the ice machine is observed with contaminants in the standing water at the bottom. The ice scoop sits in this holder consistently throughout the day. The item and contaminants were shown to the PIC and moved to dish for cleaning. Ensure that all food contact items are cleaned regularly and specifically whenever contamination has occurred.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests.

Numerous flies are observed in the dish and hand sink areas of the kitchen. The PIC was shown and instructed to contact their pest control agent (Orkin) for help in remediating the situation. A follow-up will be conducted in three weeks to allow for remediation to take affect throughout the life cycle of the flies observed.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. 

The floor in the dry storage area has dried spills and debris observed. These areas should be cleaned often enough to prevent soilage from accumulating. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean and maintain clean moving forward.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: (A) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned before each use, each time there is a change in work, between uses of raw FOODS to RTE FOODS, before using FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE, and when contamination has occurred. (C) Cleaned at least every 4 hours. 

Multiple freshly washed pans on the storing racks are observed with food debris still on them. Some of the items on these racks are dry as well and also have food debris still on them. It is believed that these items are not being completely cleaned when ran through dish. The items in question were moved back to dish for re-cleaning to correct the immediate violation. The PIC should educate staff to ensure that all dishes are completely cleaned between uses.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Test strips were not available for the chemical used in the dish machine during this inspection. Test strips were acquired during this inspection to correct. Ensure that test strips are available for any sanitizer used in the food areas at all times moving forward.
